descriptions.text: Live Ammo Ball. Live ammo balls are a common and versatile ranged weapon of the Dirigible Gnomes. These round, clamshell spheres are designed to be fired great distances using a gnomish Tickle Stick, or they may be manually lobbed like a grenade. They are also fired in large clusters from anti-aircraft point defense batteries. Just be glad you're not in charge of cleaning up that mess. A living, usually angry, creature is placed inside the ball, and the ball opens upon impact with the target. The stasis field keeps the creature within safe from injury until the ball is opened. These balls are similar in technology to pet carriers. …

recap.text: Carl finds a dead gnomish sniper with a bandolier of five fist-sized grenade balls unbroken. Donut loots it, announces that Carl has given the System AI a case of blue balls, and drops it at his feet. Each ball holds a frenzied level 11 gerbil, and Carl realises the AI wanted him to stomp one. The map fills with thousands of red dots, and gerbils burrow into Hump Town's defenders, while Donut's Wall of Fire turns them into fireballs.

Carl takes a large, egg-shaped clamshell casing, a live ammo ball too broken to hold a living creature again, and packs it with explosives and a few blocks of Mordecai's Nitro Sludge. He welds it shut, builds a little cart for Bomo to pull it on, and imbues it with Fear. The simulator says it will flatten everything within a third of a mile. The System names it Just Wait Until Your Daddy Gets Home.

beats.headline: A five-pack of gerbils
beats.text: Of three dead gnomish snipers, one has landed on his back with his bandolier unbroken: five fist-sized grenade balls. Donut loots it, announces that she believes Carl has given the System AI a case of blue balls, and drops it at his feet. Every ball contains the same thing, a frenzied gerbil, level 11. Carl remembers Crixus's throw, another sniper's shot and the Wasteland's volley of a hundred, all flying over their mark, and Ralph, the gerbil boss on the second floor. The AI wanted him to stomp one.
beats.gist: Donut loots a sniper's bandolier of five grenade balls, and each holds a level 11 frenzied gerbil.

beats.headline: Thousands of red dots
beats.text: Carl is in the middle of refusing Donut's idea that he sacrifice a squish-sized creature to the AI every morning when the map fills with thousands of red dots. They are gerbils. With snipers and chunks of the Wasteland raining from the sky, he realises, there were hundreds if not thousands of those balls up there, built to survive heavy impacts. Ten minutes into the fight the level-11 gerbils are launching themselves at Hump Town's defenders and burrowing into flesh, and Donut's Wall of Fire only turns them into miniature, gnashing fireballs.
beats.gist: Donut's Wall of Fire turns the level-11 gerbils into gnashing fireballs that still burrow into defenders.

beats.headline: Welded into a bomb
beats.text: Carl has a large, egg-shaped, clamshell bomb casing from the previous floor, a live ammo ball too broken to hold a living creature again. He fills it with explosives and a few blocks of Mordecai's Nitro Sludge, welds it closed, builds a little cart for Bomo to pull it on and, for good measure, imbues it with Fear. If it works properly, the simulator says, it will flatten everything within a third of a mile. The System names it on its own: Just Wait Until Your Daddy Gets Home.
beats.gist: Carl welds explosives and Nitro Sludge inside a broken live ammo ball casing.
